capabilities: Display tasks in a Kanban board with one column per status
Change task status by dragging cards between columns
Create saved boards with custom queries, columns, and swimlane grouping
Filter, sort, and group tasks using Tasks query syntax
Open and edit a task from its card, using the Tasks edit modal
disambiguation: Not a general Kanban plugin; cards are tasks managed by the Tasks plugin, not whole notes.
extras: Editing a task from a card requires Tasks 7.21.0 or later; installation is via Community Plugins or manual file copy.
intentEvidence: Because this plugin is built on Tasks, the board is a live view over your existing tasks
problem: Obsidian has no built-in board view over tasks, and existing Kanban plugins treat cards as notes or scan tasks independently instead of reusing the Tasks plugin.

relations.evidence: It reuses the Tasks plugin's own parser and query engine
Kanban | notes — a board is its own note, each card a line of Markdown
choose Task Board if you want a task board without depending on the Tasks plugin

summary: Kanban board view that displays tasks collected by the Tasks plugin as cards, with status columns, drag-and-drop status changes, saved boards, and query filtering.
